coverage.main: Read all ten pages of arXiv 2107.14185v3 (24 February 2022), including Sections 1-6, Algorithm 1, Tables 1-3, Figures 1-7. Also retrieved the ten-page CVF ICCV 2021 version and compared every printed percentage: 423 values in both, identical except the NRDM/FDA baseline rows for the Inc-v3 and IncRes-v2 sources in Table 1, which differ between versions (e.g., Inc-v3 NRDM Inc-v4 cell 60.3% arXiv vs 68.1% CVF).
coverage.supplement: Read the twelve-page CVF supplement: Sections A-C qualitative attention maps (Figures 1-10), D Table 1 (SI-NI comparison), E Table 2 (top-3 NIPS 2017 defenses), F Table 3 (equal iteration budget) and G (four transformation variants, single values).
coverage.excluded_results: Starred white-box diagonal cells in main Table 1 and supplement Tables 1 and 3 are excluded from transfer judgments. Figure 1 and supplement Figures 1-10 are qualitative attention visualizations.

result_groups.locator: Table 1 (p. 5); Section 5.2; Figures 5-7 normal-target panels (pp. 7-8); supplement Tables 1 and 3 and Section G
result_groups.population: ImageNet-compatible NIPS 2017 dataset of 1,000 images (Section 5.1); sources Inc-v3, IncRes-v2, Res-152, Vgg-16
result_groups.outcome: attack success rate (not defined in the paper)
result_groups.evidence: The paper names the 1,000-image dataset and reports success rates but defines neither success nor any clean-correct or source-success restriction. The released verify.py logs the fraction of all 1,000 images whose target prediction changes from its clean prediction (ground-truth success is printed but not logged); this operational definition is recorded as artifact evidence, not a reporting judgment.

result_groups.locator: Table 2 (p. 6); Table 3 ensemble source (p. 7); Figures 5-7 defense panels; supplement Table 2 (top-3 NIPS 2017 defenses)
result_groups.population: Same 1,000 images; five adversarially trained targets, and three competition defenses in the supplement; Table 3 uses an ensemble of Res-50/Res-152/Vgg-16/Vgg-19
result_groups.outcome: attack success rate (not defined in the paper)
result_groups.evidence: Same undefined success-rate metric and no stated conditioning. Table 3 prints identical PIM and PITIDIM rows (72.1/66.4/76.3/79.3/68.2), recorded as a reporting anomaly without inferring which is intended.

f1.evidence: No clean accuracy is reported for any source or target. The released evaluator computes clean accuracy but does not write it.

f2.evidence: No clean-correct filtering or explicit inclusion is stated for either group.

f3.evidence: Success rate is undefined relative to source success. The released evaluator scores every image, but paper-table correspondence is not established.

f4.evidence: One-decimal percentages over a stated 1,000-image set would map to k/1,000 only if success is computed over all 1,000 images, which the paper does not define. Supplement Table 2 mixes integer and one-decimal values (e.g., 5%, 7.8%), and Figures 5-7 are graphical. No complete unique reconstruction.

f5.locator: Section 3 Eq. 1 (p. 3); Eq. 5 (p. 5); Section 5.1 Parameter Settings (p. 6)
f5.evidence: p = infinity is adopted and 'in all experiments, the maximum perturbation epsilon = 16' with T = 10 and alpha = 1.6. The supplement's equal-iteration Table 3 changes iterations but not the stated all-experiments radius. Pixel scale is not stated explicitly; 16 with step 1.6 is consistent with 0-255.

f6.evidence: The linked release tracks attack.py, verify.py, the 1,000 PNG images with labels, and TF-slim network definitions; checkpoints are to be downloaded from the public TF-slim and adv_imagenet_models pages the paper cites. This could meet the existence criterion for at least one configuration, but checkpoint availability/identity and execution were not verified, and the logged success rate is a prediction-change rate. Recorded as a recomputation candidate.

artifact_checks.result: Cloned and pinned (last commit 9 June 2022). Tracks attack.py, verify.py, utils.py, TF-slim nets, dataset/images/1-1000.png with dev_dataset.csv and labels.txt, models_tf/url.txt and an empty log.csv. verify.py logs sum(ori_pred != adv_pred)/1000 for 14 models and prints, but does not log, clean accuracy and ground-truth success. Not executed.

bounds_checks.reason: No clean accuracy on the 1,000-image set is reported and the success-rate definition is unstated (the released evaluator logs prediction changes rather than misclassification). Not eligible without recomputation.

limitations: Non-blind evidence audit. Version-specific Table 1 baseline values must not be mixed across the CVF and arXiv versions.
